user_reported_bug: Retest of SSE reconnect resilience after fixing bug_verify_315: buffer record moved from SSE consumer (loop_stream) to producer (LoopEngine._emit line ~2464). Also removed the `finally: eng.deregister(loop_id)` from loop_stream so client disconnect no longer kills the engine. Both critical items in iteration 315's not_fixed verdict addressed.
summary: No relevant testing skill found. Focused backend retest confirms the core SSE reconnect bug is fixed: LoopEngine._emit records each event to the replay buffer before queue.put, loop_stream no longer deregisters the engine on client disconnect, and a corrected disconnect-gap probe replayed event-2 through event-5 after reconnect with the engine still registered. The old bug_verify_315 probe still exits 1, but inspection shows it is racy/off-by-one because initial replay can duplicate event-0 before the stream attaches to the live queue; the corrected probe verifies the requested key invariant. Targeted item6 tests passed 10/10, j009 passed 1/1, and the full keyword quality-gate subset matched the expected residual infra baseline: 3 failed, 383 passed, 4 skipped, 2 errors.

minor.issue: The legacy probe remains racy and still reports passed=false by reading a duplicate initial event-0/id0 before event-1; it should be updated or replaced with the corrected probe that waits until loop_stream is attached to engine.queue before emitting initial live events.

Supplementary probe showed backend can emit replayed gap events again from engine.queue after buffer replay. Frontend loopApi.js dedups by SSE seq, so this should not be user-visible, but server-side filtering/draining of already-replayed seqs would make the no-duplicate invariant cleaner.

action_items: Update the old bug_verify_315 gap probe to avoid the initial replay/live-queue race, or replace it with /app/test_reports/bug_verify_316_sse_reconnect_core_probe.py as the regression harness.
Consider server-side suppression of queued events whose seq was already replayed on reconnect; frontend dedup currently prevents duplicate user-visible application.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/services/loop_engine.py::_emit now calls services.sse_replay_buffer.record(self.loop_id, ev) before await self.queue.put(ev), satisfying producer-side recording while no SSE client is connected.
backend/routers/loop.py::loop_stream finally block now does pass instead of eng.deregister(loop_id), so closing one SSE client does not kill a running engine.
backend/routers/loop.py no longer records the local live-queue event at consumer yield; Mongo/cross-worker fallback still records last_event locally.

success_rate.backend: Core disconnect-gap probe passed; requested item6 tests 10/10 passed; j009 1/1 passed; quality-gate subset matched expected residual 3 failed / 383 passed / 4 skipped / 2 errors. Legacy bug_verify_315 probe still fails due harness race, not the disconnect-gap invariant.

rca_of_the_issue: Iteration 315 failed because only the SSE consumer populated the replay buffer and loop_stream deregistered the engine on client disconnect. The fix moved recording to LoopEngine._emit and removed disconnect-time deregistration. The old probe's remaining failure is caused by emitting event-0 before the generator has completed initial replay and attached to engine.queue, allowing event-0 to be seen from replay and then again from the live queue. A corrected probe that schedules the stream read before each emit proves events emitted during the disconnect gap are recorded and replayable.
